question: Where can I find a university inside a 170 kilometers cutoff in the northeast direction?
sql: WITH central_point AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(ST_Collect(geometry)) AS geom FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'university' ) SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, central_point AS cp WHERE p.amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, cp.geom::geography, 170 * 1000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(cp.geom, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 22.5 AND 67.5;
